description: This file implements management and state handling of VLAN trunk ports, entities, and related configurations for a network device. It contains functions to load, save, add, and remove VLAN and trunk port configurations, as well as manage entity memberships.

methods.name: int getVlanState(PVlanTrunkState * vidState,int vid)
methods.description: Searches for an existing VLAN state by VLAN ID, allocating and initializing a new one if not found.

methods.name: int saveVlanState(PVlanTrunkState vidState)
methods.description: Persists the current state of a VLAN trunk configuration, including entities and ports, to persistent storage via external API calls.

methods.name: int loadVlanState(PVlanTrunkState vidState)
methods.description: Loads VLAN configuration from external storage into internal structures, initializing entities, ports, and paths.

methods.name: int addAndGetTrunkPorts(PVlanTrunkState vidState,PPlatformPort newPort,PList listToAppend)
methods.description: Adds trunk ports associated with a specified entity or resolves dependencies if the entity is missing, returning the number of changed ports.

methods.name: int removeAndGetTrunkPorts(PVlanTrunkState vidState,PPlatformPort oldPort,PList listToAppend)
methods.description: Removes trunk port associations for a given port and entity, updating internal states and external configurations.

methods.name: int addMemberPort(PEntityPortList entity,PPlatformPort port)
methods.description: Adds a port to an entity's member list, avoiding duplicates, and marks the entity as modified.

methods.name: int remMemberPort(PEntityPortList entity,PPlatformPort port)
methods.description: Removes a port from an entity’s member list if it exists.

methods.name: int deRefEntity(PVlanTrunkState vidState,int entity,PPlatformPort port)
methods.description: De-references (removes) a port from an entity, deleting the entity if no ports remain.

methods.name: PEntityPortList getEntity(PVlanTrunkState vidState,int entity)
methods.description: Retrieves the internal representation of an entity by its ID.

methods.name: int refTrunkPort(PVlanTrunkState vidState,PPlatformPort port,PEntityPath path)
methods.description: References (adds) a trunk port to VLAN state, creating it if it does not exist, and associates a path.

methods.name: int addPathToTrunkPort(PTrunkPort port,PEntityPath path)
methods.description: Adds a dependency path to a trunk port, marking it dirty for later saving.

methods.name: PTrunkPort addTrunkPort(PVlanTrunkState vidState,PPlatformPort platport)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new trunk port to VLAN state, marking the trunk list as dirty.

methods.name: int deRefTrunkPort(PTrunkPort port,int entity)
methods.description: Removes dependency paths associated with a specific port and entity, updating the port's status.

methods.name: PEntityPortList addEntity(PVlanTrunkState vidState,int entity)
methods.description: Creates a new entity entry in VLAN state, marking the entities list as dirty.
